fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Limited Turnaround Space
fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Keep the parking area clear of vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to turn around.
• Install a reflective turnaround marker or signage so responders can quickly identify the best turning area on the property.
• Identify and communicate a secondary foot access route to neighbors or responding agencies in case the single driveway is blocked.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles, equipment, or debris that would prevent a responding vehicle from reaching the residence.
